title: Enterprise Support: Customer resource disposal
content:
Enterprise Support — Customer resource disposal.

## Policy clauses

The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract.

Only the customer may withdraw an application or terminate their provisioned resources.

An applied contract can be withdrawn without any setup, usage or termination charge.

For active or suspended contracts, record closing date from the current handling time and stop running primary meters at the exact customer-confirmed close time.

Accrued usage and actual retained-resource charges remain payable; closing never erases receivables or credits.

termination fee applies to an on-demand exit under lifecycle fee accounting.

If a signed commitment remains unexpired and commitment cancel allowed is false, invoice its recorded remaining signed commitment liability in USD as a distinct termination component, without also charging future usage against that same liability.

No new usage begins after closure; existing financial corrections, collection and refunds remain possible.

Repeating the same closed-resource confirmation has no further effect.

Before closing, the signed termination schedule supplies remaining signed commitment liability in USD and is zero when no unbilled commitment liability remains.

A positive recorded liability necessarily triggers the distinct termination charge using the disposal request as its original source reference; closure and that one invoice entry complete the event chain.

## Authoritative evidence

The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support contract reference, request reference, original source reference. Correlate the action to the same support contract reference, request reference, original source reference.
